description: This file is a shell script for creating a UBI image layout, including functions to handle UBI volume configuration and layout generation, with parameter parsing and external tool invocation.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines a UBI volume with parameters like volume ID, name, image, size, and type.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Generates the layout of UBI volumes based on provided parts, root filesystem type, kernel, and other parameters.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Sets a sequence parameter for ubinize if SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is defined.
